Play a D&D-style adventure where you can actually say whatever you want to NPCs, and the game understands you.

Warrior Quest is a dark-fantasy dungeon crawler for what people love about tabletop role-playing games like Dungeons & Dragons*: trying your own ideas and seeing how the world reacts, without having to gather a group. Fight, sneak, deceive, bargain, recruit, threaten, or try something completely different.

Warrior Quest is a Living RPG (LRPG), not a chatbot in a Dungeon Master costume. Diplomacy is wired into the game engine. What you say and agree to can change relationships, objectives, alliances, access, and the state of the world. The game keeps track of your abilities, your gear, and the deals you make, and the dice decide what works.

The AI and the voices run on your own PC, offline. No internet needed while you play.

PLAY THE FREE DEMO

The demo is act I of the full game, about an hour long, and your save carries over to the full release. Create your character, explore the dungeon, lie to a goblin and, most importantly... roll well.

Your Choices Define the Story

Warrior Quest is built around player agency.

Many encounters can be fought, avoided, sneaked past, talked through, or solved some other way. You can get through much of the game peacefully. Violence, deception, greed, and cruelty all have consequences.

You are not required to be the hero. You are responsible for deciding who your character becomes.

Choose Your Adventurer

Play as one of three distinct classes, each offering its own abilities, equipment preferences, and approach to danger:

  • Warrior

  • Thief

  • Wizard

Your class shapes how you confront the world, but it does not decide your personality or morality. Any adventurer can negotiate, deceive, show mercy, recruit allies, or choose violence.

A Complete Mini-Campaign

Warrior Quest is structured like a tabletop mini-campaign: longer and more involved than a one-shot, but more focused than a sprawling full campaign.

Different classes, backgrounds, routes, and improvised diplomacy choices provide reasons to return and tell a different version of the story.

Built by an Engineer and a Dungeon Master

Warrior Quest is created by a solo developer with a decade of experience in both software engineering and running tabletop campaigns.

It combines authored rules, dice systems, characters, and persistent world states with the freedom to improvise.

The writing, artwork, music, sound, and original voice performances were created by the developer. The LLM behind its diplomacy system is used only as a gameplay mechanic, not as a substitute for creating the game.

*Warrior Quest is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Wizards of the Coast.

Your Settlement. Your Allies. Your Path to Victory.

Your smithies need resources. Your settlement needs food. And at your border, a neighbor’s army is growing. Do you invest in new production buildings, strengthen your defenses – or secure a trading partner before competition turns into war?

Warstead combines living settlement building with resource management, research, diplomacy, and tactical real-time combat. Gather resources, get your economy running, and decide how you want to hold your ground against your rivals. Not every conflict requires an army. Sometimes a good deal is the smarter next move.

Build a Settlement That Truly Works

From your first buildings, a complex network of resource gathering, craftsmanship, and supply begins to take shape. Businesses need workers, goods need storage space, and your production chains need to work together.

Goods physically move through your settlement: carriers transport resources and finished products between workplaces and storage buildings. Short routes keep your economy moving. If an important material is missing, an entire production chain can grind to a halt.

What matters is not only what you build – but also where you build it and in what order.

If You Want to Grow, You Need to Feed Your Settlers

The next smithy is already planned. But do you have enough food for the people who are supposed to work there?

Without food, your settlers will gradually starve. A reliable food supply keeps them alive. At the same time, the quality of your food affects population growth: The higher the quality of your food, the faster your population grows.

Secure your basic food supply and continue developing your food production. This gives you the foundation for new workers, additional businesses, and a larger settlement.

An Army Is Only as Strong as the Economy Behind It

Command swordsmen, archers, and musketeers in real time. Combine melee and ranged units, protect your shooters, and secure important positions.

An attack on enemy production buildings can hit your rival hard. But while your troops advance, your own settlement remains vulnerable. Decide when to attack, what to defend, and when a retreat is worth more than a costly victory.

The next campaign does not begin at the border – it begins in your mines, workshops, and smithies.

Trade in Goods – and in Opportunities

Buy missing goods, sell your surplus, and bridge shortages through your trading house. Purchased goods must also be transported and stored after they arrive.

You will also encounter gnomes, goblins, and moslings with different trade offers across the map. Their food, tools, and resources can save your economy or accelerate your expansion. But help costs coins – and a destroyed trading partner will not supply you later.

Good relations open up new options: improve your standing with other factions through trade, work toward alliances, or negotiate peace. Whether the other side agrees depends on your relationship and on their personality.

A neighbor can become your next enemy. Or the ally who gives you the time you need to grow.

Expeditions & New Horizons

Build your ship, load supplies at the harbor, and set sail on dangerous expeditions. Your supplies and decisions determine whether you return with valuable discoveries.

Discover 30 items across five rarity tiers. Equip your finds in the Village Centre to boost eligible buildings. The expedition system is already integrated into singleplayer and multiplayer.

Planned for the future: selling goods through the harbor and settling new islands. These additional harbor features have not yet been implemented.

Research Your Own Path

At the Scholar’s House, you develop your strengths across four areas: Military, Trade, Production, and Technology.

Increase the output of your mines, reduce material consumption in production, or improve your sales revenue. Increase the damage, attack speed, and range of your troops, or unlock new production possibilities.

But not every advantage can be combined with every other one. Limited specializations and mutually exclusive research paths make your choices matter.

Faster production or lower material consumption? Stronger archers or better-trained musketeers? Choose the upgrades that match your strategy.

You are not simply researching more. You are deciding what your settlement becomes better at.

New Map. New Starting Conditions. New Plan.

Procedurally generated maps present you with new decisions every time. Forests, coastlines, bodies of water, and resource deposits determine where you expand and which routes you need to secure.

Adjust map size, water coverage, forest density, and ore deposits. With the map seed, you can recreate the same starting world and find out whether a different strategy leads to better results this time.

Choose AI opponents, difficulty levels, and personalities: traders, builders, and warlords each focus on different priorities. An adjustable peace period gives you time to build up. Will you use it for supplies and research – or will your army already be waiting when the peace ends?

Decide What Victory Means to You

Domination: Defeat your rivals and decide the struggle for power in your favor.

Wealth: Reach the defined goals for coins and population before your competitors do.

Score: Achieve the highest score before the selected game time runs out. Population, buildings, stored goods, and coins all contribute to your result.

Endless Mode: Keep building without a fixed victory condition and experiment with different economic and research paths.

Build with foresight. Trade wisely. Fight for what you have created.

Follow Warstead's continuing development and find your own path to victory.

Development status – Warstead is still being developed

Warstead is still in development and is not yet finished. The game accidentally left Early Access on Steam ahead of schedule. This was my mistake during publication, not a planned completion of development.

After a long night of development and a very early start the next morning, I apparently still had enough energy to click – unfortunately, it was the wrong click. I apologise for the mistake and the confusion it caused.

Work on Warstead continues: bug fixes, improvements and new content remain on the agenda. Before buying, please bear in mind that bugs, unfinished areas and changes to game mechanics may still occur. Thank you for your patience, your feedback and for accompanying Warstead on its journey.

Important: multiplayer access is currently limited

Multiplayer is still in development and currently has limited availability. You can already join existing multiplayer matches. However, creating and hosting your own matches is currently restricted to selected players who have been granted access. Please consider this restriction before buying, particularly if you want to play Warstead with friends and host a match yourself.

Was Silence (고요였다)

2D Visual Novel | Narrative Adventure

Barely hearing the sounds of the world.

Boundaries between dream and waking blur.

There, three people await.

Loss and Will

This is a story about human resilience in the face of absence.

The senses fade. Yet something becomes clearer.

Bond. Voice. Will.

Features

Visual Novel

A text-and-image visual novel.

Top-Down Adventure

In certain chapters, the perspective shifts to a top-down view where you explore spaces directly.

QTE Crisis Moments

At pivotal turning points in the story, intuitive QTE sequences heighten the tension.

Korean Sign Language (KSL) System

In select chapters, a sign language interaction system appears — players experience KSL as part of the narrative.

Chapter Structure

A prologue and 9 chapters. Each chapter centers on a different loss, bringing its own unique presentation and gameplay

system.

A Story Without Combat

There is no combat. You follow the story through conversation and exploration.

Some scenes show fire or depict a seizure, and the story deals with loss and psychological trauma.

A few later scenes include brief flashing screen effects.

Accessibility

  • Subtitles: Korean / English / Japanese

  • Subtitle size adjustment (small, medium, large)

  • Korean Sign Language (KSL) animations built-in

  • Photosensitivity notice: some scenes contain brief flashing visuals.

About the Developer

PWOK Entertainment — Republic of Korea

This game was made for everyone.

WATCH MY STEP!

Don't trust everything you see. Your teammate might see a danger that is completely invisible to you.

Watch My Step! is a 2–4 player online co-op platforming and trap game where everyone follows the same course, but each player can see different traps.

The path ahead may look completely safe to you... while a deadly trap is sitting right there on your teammate's screen.

Communicate with your teammates, describe the dangers you can see, and listen carefully to their warnings. You can't rely on your own eyes if you want to reach the finish.

EVERY PLAYER SEES DIFFERENT TRAPS

Even when you're standing in exactly the same place, you may not be seeing the same thing.

A trap visible to one player can be completely invisible to everyone else. Describe their positions and timing to each other and work together to find a safe path forward.

MOVE FORWARD TOGETHER

Run, jump, avoid traps, and reach checkpoints as a team.

When one player reaches a checkpoint, progress is saved for the entire team. But be careful: every failure adds a 30-second penalty to your final time.

RACE AGAINST THE CLOCK

Your goal isn't just to finish the course. It's to finish it as fast as possible.

Find the right balance between speed and caution and keep improving your team's best time.

CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS

Compete against other players on separate leaderboards for 2, 3, and 4-player teams.

Improve your communication, discover better routes, reduce your mistakes, and keep trying for the fastest time.

YOU CAN ALSO PLAY ALONE

In single-player mode, every trap is visible. Use this mode to learn the map, controls, and traps.

However, the main Watch My Step! experience is the 2–4 player online co-op mode where each player sees different dangers. Times achieved in single-player mode are not submitted to the leaderboards.

Watch Party is a virtual movie theater where you and your friends watch the web together — synced, in the same room, with voice chat, board games, and popcorn you can actually throw. No friends online? Browse public rooms and meet someone new over a movie.

Host a room, paste a link, and the big screen lights up for everyone at the same time. Talk over the movie with positional voice chat, queue up what's next, challenge a friend to chess while the video plays, or just sink into a couch and hang out.

Watch Videos Together

  • Synced big-screen viewing — YouTube and other popular video sites play in perfect sync for everyone in the room. Paste a link and it works on most sites.

  • Proximity Voice chat — voices come from where people are standing, so the back row can gossip while the front row watches.

  • Shared queue — line up videos with your friends to queue up the next video.

  • Extra screens throughout the map let you lounge wherever you like, with quiet corners available whenever you want a little privacy away from the crowd.

Board Games

  • Board games at the table — Chess, Checkers, Connect 4, and Go (9x9), playable head-to-head while the movie runs. Invite a friend, claim a seat, rematch till dawn.

Character Customization

  • build your look in a full character editor: face, hair, outfits, and colors, with feminine and masculine starting bases to sculpt from.

Become a fish, explore various maps, power up, and defeat the bosses!

  • Experience a new adventure where you swim freely as if flying, encountering diverse environments and creatures.

  • Play through multiple runs to complete achievements and collect items, enemy encyclopedias, and endings.

  • Experience various random items and diverse enemy gimmicks for a fresh playthrough every time.

  • Make deep and weighty philosophical choices to find your ending. Enjoy different music for each map and feel the catharsis.

Controls: Players generally use WASD and the mouse to change direction, Shift or Right Mouse Click to dash, and Left Mouse Click for a water bubble attack.

Playstyle: The player's upgrade path is divided into two main branches: defeating enemies to gain EXP orbs to acquire and upgrade auto-cast skills, or acquiring items that provide various stat boosts or add new gimmicks.

Waveguard


Waveguard is a roguelike tower defense where every run is built around powerful synergies. Assemble your team of towers, strengthen it with formidable artifacts, and hold out against increasingly dangerous waves of enemies.


At the start of each run, your defenses are still fragile and only one question matters: how will you survive this time? Place your towers, make the most of their strengths, adjust their targeting, and gradually turn your strategy into a true war machine. A bouncing projectile, a perfectly timed elemental effect, a thriving economy, or an unexpected combination of artifacts can completely change the course of a run.


Make your choices in the shop between waves. Buy a new tower, increase your damage, prioritize speed, reinforce your defenses, or prepare a riskier combination: every decision can bring you closer to victory… or leave you vulnerable to the next assault. Raw power is not enough—you will need to make the most of what the game offers and build a coherent strategy to prevail.


Choose the game mode that suits you. In Story mode, progress through handcrafted maps and waves until the final victory. In Endless mode, survive for as long as possible on procedurally generated maps against ever more fearsome waves. Discover a new map every five waves, face powerful bosses, and accept cursed artifacts capable of turning the rules of the run upside down.


Explore a pixel-art world made up of varied zones, each populated by enemies and bosses with their own unique traits. The further you progress, the tougher the challenges become: enemies grow more powerful, bosses exploit weaknesses in your defenses, and higher difficulty levels demand increasingly precise choices.


Waveguard combines the clarity of tower defense with the replayability of a roguelike: fast-paced runs, frequent decisions, a collection to complete, and the constant urge to start over with a new team composition.

Features

  • A roguelike tower defense focused on synergies between towers, artifacts, and bonuses.

  • More than 10 towers with distinct roles, allowing you to create a wide variety of team compositions.

  • More than 80 artifacts capable of transforming your damage, projectiles, economy, and chances of survival.

  • Multiple game modes, including a handcrafted Story campaign and an unlimited challenge on procedurally generated maps in Endless mode.

  • A varied pixel-art world filled with many enemies and bosses to learn and counter.

  • A shop between waves that lets you steer each run toward a different strategy.

  • Multiple difficulty levels, ranging from accessible runs to the most unforgiving challenges.

  • Persistent progression with collections, statistics, Steam achievements, leaderboards, and Steam Cloud saves.


Build your defenses, find the right combinations, and take on increasingly difficult challenges. In Waveguard, every run is a new opportunity to devise the strategy that will carry you through one more wave.

Collect eggs!

Hover your cursor over eggs to collect them. Turn piles of eggs into coins, one satisfying pop at a time.

Grow your flock!

Buy new chicken types, hatch little chicks, and fill your farm with even more eggs. Some chickens boost the whole flock!

Upgrade everything!

Collect faster, reach more eggs, and make every egg worth more. Spend your coins to keep the numbers climbing!

Get some help!

Hire workers to collect alongside you. Frogs get chickens laying, while bees coat eggs in honey for extra value!

Crack giant eggs!

Crack giant eggs to unleash temporary boosts, from frantic egg laying to a powerful magnetic cursor. Reach goals to unlock more events!

Come back stronger!

Sacrifice your farm to activate permanent skill tree upgrades. Unlock chain reactions, magnetic pulls, and new chicken types for your next run!

You are a humble fisher trying to make a living, and lucky for you there are Way Too Many Fish! Your job is to throw every flopping fish into the right crate, then cash them in.

Sort Way Too Many Species

Drop your net anywhere in open water and haul up a pile from 82 species. Grab a fish, find its crate, and toss it in. Separate the junk from the catch, and throw the protected ones back over the rail. Buy licenses to unlock new species, each with its own crate.

Sail to New Waters

Push further out into regions you haven't fished yet. Drop anchor at the island, spend your money at the stall, and have a poke around the beach while you're there. The locals are cats, and they're very fond of fish.

Upgrade Your Boat

Spend your hard-earned cash at the island stall to unlock bigger nets, longer reach, and a few more tricks for handling all these flopping fish.

Thanks for checking out my game! :)

A cruel road ahead 

A sealed dispatch. A threat ahead. Three unlikely companions with a long way to go. Lead the Vanguard, Huntress and Mage through a dark fantasy world where a narrow bridge can be a death trap - and the right card can make it yours.

Waywardens is a tactical roguelite deckbuilder about making three heroes work as one. Build a shared deck, read the battlefield and find a way through encounters where position matters as much as power.





Three heroes. One shared hand. Every card is a plan.

One hand. Three heroes. A hundred ways out.

Use every card with any hero, or put it in the right hands for a stronger class effect. Let the Vanguard open a lane, send the Huntress through it, then bring the Mage into position to protect the company. The order of your plays can change the entire turn.

Every card is a move, too.

Play a card for its action, or spend it on a chess-inspired movement pattern. Straight lines, diagonals and sudden jumps turn your hand into a map of possibilities. That attack you were saving might be the escape route you need.

See the threat. Change the outcome.

Enemies move and reveal their attacks before you act. Step out of a killing lane, push a foe off a bridge, or leave two enemies in each other’s way. Use obstacles, high ground and narrow approaches to make a dangerous board work for you.

Build a company that survives the road.

Choose a route through battles, treasure, dangerous elites and welcome inns. Add cards to the shared deck, collect relics that shape your party, and equip individual heroes for the role you need them to play. Spend your gold on another advantage - or save it to get everyone home alive.

A beautiful place to meet an ugly end.

Fight across ashen riverbanks, frozen burial grounds, scorched stone, drowned marshes and lands warped by the void. Illustrated heroes and enemies stand on miniature battlefields, with a grim comic-book world waiting beyond each fight.

Pack light. Think ahead.

  • Three heroes, one shared deck: combine their strengths without managing separate hands.

  • Two uses for each card: choose its action or its movement.

  • Readable enemy attacks: plan around what is about to happen.

  • Small battlefields with sharp consequences: exploit lanes, obstacles and deadly edges.

  • A different company each run: build around cards, equipment, relics and starting loadouts.

There’s always another way through.
Find yours.

Wishlist

Wishlist Waywardens if you like tactical games where every turn feels like a small puzzle, every card has more than one purpose, and the best play is the one you saw coming two moves ago.

Your legion takes on enemy armies automatically: your units advance and fight without you having to control every soldier. But you take part in the action too! Aim at enemies with your cursor to deal damage and support your troops on the battlefield. Prepare your army, strengthen your soldiers, and use your abilities to help lead your legion to victory.

Grow your army and strengthen your units through the skill tree. Unlock upgrades to increase their damage, toughness, or attack speed, and decide which aspects of your legion to focus on. As you progress, your choices shape your strategy and help you face increasingly formidable enemies.

Battles are automatic, but you can directly influence how they unfold. Equip your active abilities before battle, then activate them when the situation calls for it. Whether you are facing a wave of enemies or a tough opponent, the right timing can make all the difference. Get to know your abilities and choose the ones that best suit your playstyle.

Collect loot as you progress, especially by defeating bosses, then equip your finds at camp. Items provide passive bonuses that strengthen your legion and complement the upgrades you have already unlocked. Combine equipment, abilities, and progression upgrades to create your build: a set of choices that work together to give your army its strengths.

Your general accompanies your soldiers and fights alongside them. Each general has a specialty and grants bonuses to your legion for as long as they remain alive. Recruit new generals, discover their strengths, and select the one that best fits your strategy. Your choice is an integral part of your build and can enhance your army’s strengths or offset some of its weaknesses.

Intercepted transmission fragment: "…the subject is awake. Begin the evaluation."

Officially, you don't exist. You wake up in a sealed metal room, a voice calls it "tests", and no one is coming for you.



Spiked walls, jets of scalding steam, pistons, gas, laser curtains. The traps never stop, and you only find out which one is waiting for you once the door is open. Watch, wait for the right moment, or run. You are not the first to come through here: the bodies prove it.



Other subjects share the facility. Some will help you. Others will wait for you to turn your back, or gang up three at a time to be sure. And when everything breaks down, you have to fight. Three paths open up before you, and none of them is free. The game shows no morality meter, but it forgets nothing.



Dozens of cameras cover the facility. A voice comments on your every move, provokes you, judges you. You can watch the screens too: a cell, a door opening, someone who doesn't know they're being filmed. Then the screen cuts to SIGNAL LOST. Further on, in the infirmary, you are asked a simple routine question. Your answer decides which trial awaits you.



Surviving is only the beginning. The facility doesn't just evaluate you, it settles you in: a cafeteria, a greenhouse, a library, a room with your name on it. The other subjects live here, some of them for a very long time. The more normal this life feels, the less you'll ask what it costs.



Here, nobody survives by luck. Between tests, the facility trains you: hold out against waves of robots, cross the courses between pistons and electrified tiles, go down into the labyrinth in the dark with whatever lurks there, reach the evacuation elevator through trapped rooms. Every training has its own online leaderboard. Alone, or two players on the same screen. And now, two players online.



  • Trapped rooms to explore freely: go forward, double back, find another way
  • Traps that never switch off: spiked walls, scalding steam, pistons, gas, lasers
  • Choices that matter, and several endings depending on how you play
  • A dozen survivors: possible allies, certain traitors
  • Between tests, a life in the colony: a room, routines, bonds, and what they cost
  • An ever-present voice that comments, provokes and judges (voices in French and English)
  • Text and subtitles in 17 languages
  • Close-quarters combat, against robots and against other subjects
  • Replayable trainings (Survival, Labyrinth, Evacuation, Courses), with online leaderboards
  • Local 2-player split screen (Versus races, Duo Survival): requires a controller and a keyboard (or two controllers)
  • Online 2-player multiplayer in all four training modes: quick match or invite a Steam friend

Inspired by paranoid sci-fi closed-room thrillers like Cube. The real question isn't "how do I get out", but "who will you be when you do".

We Don't Exist is still in active development: more content will arrive before release.

We're Gonna Need More Fireballs is a incremental rogue-like tower defense game about defending a single crystal heart against enormous swarms of enemies.

Thirty towers, thirty machines

Towers don't share a weapon rack. A magma throat spits slag, a mycelium mother

lobs cauldrons of gas, a thorn blowgun fires a stream of spores, a hunger rose

plants itself in the swarm's own path. Picking the tower IS picking the spell —

each one built and animated as its own machine.

Can you discover all combos?

A million of them

Not twenty enemies per wave. Hundreds of thousands on screen at once, with larger maps unleashing seemingly endless hordes before the battle is over. The swarm floods every tunnel from wall to wall, thinning where your defenses burn through it, only to surge forward and fill the gaps again.

Upgrade tree

Crystals earned every run, won or lost, unlock new spells, new towers, hexes... and deeper

branches. The map doesn't get easier — you get heavier.

What if, in another world, we had never met—

What color would our youth be then?

We, Situated in a Parallel World ~Parallel Hearts~ is a school-life ensemble visual novel about youth, friendship, and the everyday moments shared between childhood friends.

Through the eyes of Hibiki Hinata, you’ll spend your high school days alongside his endlessly energetic childhood friend and a colorful cast of companions—days filled with noise, mishaps, laughter, and moments you’ll eventually wish could last just a little longer.

I Only Wanted Five More Minutes of Sleep

To Hibiki Hinata, youth has never seemed quite as dazzling as people make it sound.

Romance and youthful passion? He’s far more concerned with whether the opening ceremony could start a little later.

Then Nanase comes racing down the cherry-blossom-covered slope, calling his name.

And just like that, Hibiki’s plan for a quiet high school life is completely shattered.

He complains that everything is a hassle, yet somehow always ends up lending a hand. The two of them have been together for so long that each other’s presence feels completely natural—and yet a teasing remark or an unexpected moment of closeness can still make their hearts skip a beat.

The feelings neither of them knows how to put into words remain hidden inside the familiar banter they have long taken for granted.

Somehow, Their Youth Is Always a Little Off Track

Inside the chemistry lab of the old school building, VVVV carefully watches the changes taking place inside a test tube, while Zhizi has already collapsed onto the desk and drifted off into a universe of her own.

One tries to explain everything through science.

The other claims she can receive radio signals from outer space.

They seem to be on completely different wavelengths, yet somehow they share a strangely peaceful kind of after-school time together.

Of course, that peace rarely lasts for long.

Whenever the others show up, even the most ordinary afternoon has a way of veering wildly off course.

Hina, who dreams of becoming an idol, can turn almost any situation into a lively spectacle. Kirikawa, always wearing headphones, is perfectly at ease in the world of games, yet becomes strangely awkward whenever someone gets too close.

Then there’s Zhizi, the self-proclaimed receiver of cosmic transmissions; Lanshao, who never runs out of fiery declarations; and ABtype, the one responsible for calmly pointing out just how ridiculous everyone else is being.

With completely different personalities, hobbies, and rhythms, they gradually become the kind of friends who wait for one another after school—and who always seem to show up together whenever trouble comes knocking.

Turn Ordinary Days Into Stories Worth Remembering

From springtime on campus to a winter trip, from an unexpected visitor on Christmas Eve to wishes written on ema at a New Year shrine—and, of course, the exam crisis no one can escape—

Across 26 chapters, you’ll follow this group of friends through one encounter, mishap, and ridiculous incident after another.

Sometimes it’s pure chaos that practically begs for a sarcastic comment.

Other times, everything suddenly grows quiet enough for an honest conversation.

And somewhere within those seemingly insignificant moments, the distance between friendship and love begins to change.

What You’ll Experience

  • 26 chapters of school-life storytelling, blending lighthearted comedy, friendship, and the feelings shared between childhood friends

  • A colorful cast of distinct characters brought to life through expressive character sprites, story CGs, background music, and sound effects

  • Chinese voice acting for selected characters, adding another layer of warmth to their everyday interactions

  • Choices in certain scenes that can trigger different dialogue and character reactions

  • Revisit your favorite moments through the CG Gallery, Character Archive, Chapter Select, and Dialogue History

  • Text available in Simplified Chinese and Japanese

Perhaps, in some parallel world, we were nothing more than strangers who passed each other by.

But here, someone calls your name on the way to school. Someone saves you a seat. And someone hides a simple “I care about you” inside a complaint that sounds anything but honest.

This is We, Situated in a Parallel World ~Parallel Hearts~.

A story of youth that begins with “What a pain…”—and slowly becomes something you never want to say goodbye to.

A Message from the Creator

Thank you for taking the time to check out We, Situated in a Parallel World ~Parallel Hearts~.

Through this project, I wanted to give my virtual streamer friends another kind of digital immortality, allowing them to live on in a different form within this story.

Some parts of the story were also inspired by experiences we shared while playing games together.

Above all, thank you for playing!

Wealth of Nations

Take control of a nation and guide it through decades of economic, political, and social challenges. Build a prosperous economy, manage public finances, respond to crises, and shape your country's future in a deep grand-strategy simulation inspired by real-world economics.

Every decision matters. Adjust tax policy, shape government spending, allocate public budgets, and respond to emerging crises. Your choices influence economic growth, public finances, political stability, investor confidence, and your nation's standing in the world.

A Professional Economic Simulation

At the heart of Wealth of Nations lies a sophisticated macroeconomic simulation inspired by real-world economic relationships, academic research, and modern economic modeling.

Unlike traditional strategy games that rely on simple scripted modifiers, Wealth of Nations simulates how key economic indicators interact over time. Economic growth, inflation, unemployment, government debt, public finances, financial markets, and political stability influence one another through dynamic feedback mechanisms, creating an evolving and believable national experience.

Policies rarely produce immediate results. Decisions made today may create consequences months or even years later, forcing players to think beyond short-term gains and develop sustainable long-term strategies.

Interest rates and monetary conditions are influenced by an autonomous central bank that reacts to changing economic conditions. Governments must adapt their policies to the economic environment rather than directly controlling every aspect of the economy.

Every country follows its own path based on economic conditions, political decisions, unexpected events, and long-term development.

Manage Your Economy

Monitor and steer the key indicators that define your nation's future:

  • GDP Growth

  • Inflation

  • Unemployment

  • Government Debt

  • Fiscal Balance

  • Interest Rates

  • Sovereign Credit Rating

  • Bond Market Confidence

  • Political Stability

Balance short-term political pressures against long-term economic sustainability. A booming economy may fuel inflation, while excessive debt can undermine investor confidence and increase borrowing costs. Every choice creates opportunities, trade-offs, and risks.

Shape National Policy

Implement policies that directly affect your country's development:

  • Taxation

  • Government Spending

  • Budget Allocation

  • Debt Management

  • Fiscal Rules and Debt Brakes

  • Structural Reforms

There is no universal solution. A policy that succeeds under one set of economic conditions may fail under another. Adapting to changing circumstances is essential for long-term success.

Govern Your Nation

Choose your leader, appoint ministers, and build a government capable of delivering your programme. Negotiate with coalition partners, secure support for reforms, and respond to regional elections and demands. Defend your decisions in talk shows and election debates, where your answers and promises can influence public opinion. Economic success alone does not guarantee political survival.

Shape Society and Industry

Influence individual sectors through taxation, subsidies, and investment. Expand public ownership, establish state enterprises, or privatize holdings. Balance the costs and responsibilities of ownership against your economic and political goals, while trade and exchange rates connect domestic industry to the wider world.

Shape migration, integration, and citizenship policies, and follow arrivals and departures by country, age, gender, and education. Choose how healthcare and pensions are organized and funded. Regional programmes let you address local needs, while changing demographics and public services influence households, public finances, and political support.

Face Dynamic Events

No two playthroughs are identical.

Respond to economic shocks, political crises, social unrest, financial instability, demographic challenges, and international developments. Unexpected events can rapidly change the course of your nation and force you to rethink your strategy.

Will you stimulate the economy during a recession? Reduce debt during periods of growth? Invest in long-term prosperity or prioritize short-term political stability?

The future of your country depends on your decisions.

Plan for the Long Term

Build resilient institutions, maintain public trust, manage public finances responsibly, and create sustainable prosperity. Short-term popularity may come at the expense of long-term stability, while difficult reforms can deliver lasting benefits for future generations.

The choices you make today may shape your nation for decades to come.

A Living World

Other governments hold elections, set priorities, and make policy decisions that can affect your economy through trade and international relationships. Develop diplomatic ties, pursue European initiatives and trade agreements, and respond to international crises. Global developments create new opportunities and challenges throughout your campaign.

No two nations, and no two campaigns, will ever develop in exactly the same way.

Designed for Strategy Enthusiasts

Wealth of Nations is designed for players who enjoy deep strategic decision-making and meaningful consequences.

A guided tutorial introduces the main mechanics through practical decisions. Advisors and contextual explanations help you understand your choices and their consequences as your campaign develops.

Whether you are interested in economics, politics, public policy, finance, or grand strategy games, Wealth of Nations offers a rich simulation where understanding the system is just as important as mastering it.

Can you lead your nation to prosperity?

...The afterlife has terrible traffic flow.

Welcome to Hell Resort! is a spatial-puzzle deckbuilding tower defense game where you lay down the very corridors enemies walk along and combine defensive facilities to build your interception line.

Hell is in chaos from aging infrastructure and budget shortages. Having worked in resort development in the living world, you are well versed in designing the flow of people. A young Enma invites you to redevelop hell's districts.





You do more than place towers along a fixed road—you design the route itself.

Rotate and flip L-shaped, S-shaped, and U-shaped corridor tiles to connect paths and stretch the enemy march as long as possible.

There is no time limit during the placement phase. Unupgraded facilities refund 100% of their build cost when retrieved, letting you tear down paths and towers to redesign your layout from scratch whenever you like.

Once a wave begins, all you need to do is time the dispatch of your blocker units (wardens)—no frantic building or path-swapping required.





Around your extended corridors, fit three distinct types of facilities together like a puzzle.

Turrets: Strike from Outside the Path

From rapid-fire towers tucked inside corners to long-range ballistas that pierce down straightaways and area-of-effect artillery, turrets shine when their firing arcs match the shape of your path.



Traps and Floor Hazards: Wear Down the Crowd

Build floor hazards directly into the route to inflict damage over time, slow enemies down, or knock them backward. The longer you make the corridor, the more traps enemies are forced to cross.



Garrisons: Hold the Front Line

Place gates and garrisons at key chokepoints. Send allied units (wardens) onto the path to hold enemy crowds in place while your turrets and traps rain down fire.





Corridors and defensive facilities are collected as blueprint cards.

Before entering a stage, build a deck from your collection, then use your starting hand and funds to set up your initial defense line and launch the wave.

Each time you survive a wave, draft new cards from candidates drawn from your deck to add to your hand. Use the funds earned from defeated enemies and your newly drafted cards to extend the route and expand or upgrade your facilities for the next wave.

Survive every wave to clear the stage and earn new blueprint cards to strengthen your deck for the next district.

Pack your deck with compact facilities to fill every gap, or save up land and funds for massive structures—your deck shapes how your board grows in every stage.



How will you lay out your routes and defenses on limited land? Design your own optimal solution.

Uncle Karl is gone. His garage is yours now.


He left behind a run-down backstreet garage, a stack of debts, and a dream he never finished. The garage door sticks, the lights flicker, and decades of oil stains cover the floor. Customers still find their way into the courtyard—but earning their trust is now up to you.

Listen. Test. Decide.


Customers arrive with symptoms, not ready-made answers. Inspect each car and narrow the problem down to faults in the engine, brakes, exhaust, or lights. Every test gives you more certainty, but it also uses valuable time from the working day.




Keep testing until you are sure—or trust your hunch and commit to a diagnosis. A correct call builds your reputation and leaves the customer satisfied. A wrong guess immediately costs time and reputation.

Prepare the quote


Once you have diagnosed the problem, choose whether to quote for the main fault or include additional work, then set your price. A cheaper quote is easier to accept; a higher one earns more if the customer agrees. Budgets, patience, personality, and your reputation all influence the decision.


The car goes up on the lift


Accepted jobs are carried out in your garage: the part is fetched from the storeroom, the car goes up on the lift, and the repair plays out in visible stages — while you keep an eye on the clock and the next customer. Complete jobs, get paid, invest in the garage, and make every working day count.


A warm, worn-in garage


Weathered walls, old signs, warm lighting, a quiet 1980s-inspired Berlin backstreet, and a cinematic soundtrack give the garage its character. WerkstattManager is a focused management game about observation, judgment, and honest work—not a wrench-by-wrench simulation built around endless spreadsheets.


What awaits you


  • Diagnose faults across the engine, brakes, exhaust, and lights
  • Choose between careful testing and the risk of trusting a hunch
  • Set low, fair, or high quotes with visible acceptance chances
  • Meet customers with different personalities, budgets, and patience
  • Face immediate consequences for your decisions
  • Repairs that play out in the garage – part fetched, car on the lift, stage by stage
  • Develop the garage with the money you earn

Planned for the full version


The full version is meant to turn a one-man workshop into a real business:


  • Hire employees – eventually you stop turning every wrench yourself and start running a team
  • Paint shop and bodywork bay – dents, rust, and respraying as areas of their own
  • Towing service – a call comes in and you decide whether the trip is worth it. On site you negotiate: repair it, buy the car outright, strip it for parts, or fix it up and sell it on
  • Uncle Karl's project car – the covered dream car behind the garage, finished piece by piece
  • A bigger garage – more lifts, more parking spaces, and real stock management

The full version is in development – its scope may still change.


Bring Karl's garage back to life—one job at a time.

Quit While You're Ahead or Push Your Luck?

Every turn, after your movement roll, the road holds out a second die. Settle for what you have, or risk it and dash! Clear the safe numbers to soar ahead. Bust and pay the toll. The final climb to Thunderclap Summit is filled with high-risk, high-reward scenarios for whoever is trailing behind!

Eight Pilgrims, Each With Unique Talents

Sun Wukong makes demons give way; grunts scatter on sight. Sandy absorbs blows that flatten others. Pigsy feasts for extra steps, while the White Dragon Horse gallops with extra dice. Find your favorite pilgrim and master their unique playstyle!

Demon Kings & Boss Gate Duels

Three perilous gates bar the road, guarded by ten random Demon Kings who warp the dice rules in cunning ways. Strike down the White Bone Demon through her triple disguises. If you fall, regroup and charge again!

Five Modes, One Road West

Classic is the pure race: no dash rounds, just events, items and the spaces you land on. One-shot gives you a single push per turn, safe in the early zones and a fortune in the late ones. Streak chains dash after dash into a growing pot, and one bust wipes the whole thing out. Charge turns your pushes into Qi that banks between turns until you unleash a mighty technique. Custom hands you the rulebook itself: nineteen dials, three slots to save your own house rules, and ready-made flavors like Hell Road West, Blitz Run and Draw a Lot.

One Table, Eighteen Languages

Play solo against the CPU, take up to eight pilgrims online with your Steam friends, or pass the keyboard around the couch. Every player reads the game in their own language at the same table, and all eighteen are fully translated: menus, tutorials, items, achievements and every Demon King's rulebook.

Living Ink-Wash & Achievements

The game is full of classical Chinese motifs: ink-wash painting laid down with brush, ink, paper and inkstone, dragon patterns, hanging scrolls and the pipa. The visual assets were generated using Google Flow. Claude assisted with programming. Lingrujiang, my wife, played the pipa and arranged the accompanying instruments with Suno AI. A few tracks are traditional melodies; the rest are original.

Features

  • 5 game modes: Classic, One-shot, Streak, Charge and Custom
  • 8 playable pilgrims, each with a signature technique and a passive of their own
  • 10 Demon Kings across 3 boss gates, every one of them bending the dice rules a different way
  • 12 roaming sprites and 15 items to spring, steal, hoard and misfire
  • 19 custom dials, ready-made rule sets, and 3 slots to save the house rules you build
  • 1 to 8 players: solo against the CPU, online with Steam friends, or hot-seat on one machine
  • 81 achievements: the pilgrims of the novel pass exactly 81 trials on the road west, so there are exactly 81 medals, displayed in the Compendium beside the Scenes and Victories you unlock
  • 18 languages, all of them complete
  • The pipa music was played by my wife Lingrujiang, who arranged the accompanying instruments with Suno AI
  • Keyboard and mouse or full controller support, on Windows, macOS and Steam Deck

The Story Behind the Game

This is a board game I played as a kid.

I bought a Journey to the West board game at a corner shop for one yuan: a paper board, four pieces, and a single die. I'd round up one to three friends, we'd sit around it and roll our way from space 1 to space 100. That board was lost long ago, but the tension, the cheering and the laughter around that table never left me.

I have always loved games. Years later that old board came back to me, and I rebuilt it as a hobby: apart from work and sleep, nearly every hour went into it, and I loved every minute. My wife has been learning the pipa for two years, and every pipa note in the game is hers. A modern take on qin se he ming, two instruments in harmony: I write the game, she plays the pipa.

Westward Dash is an indie game made by one person. I hope you enjoy it.

Dedicated to the friends who once threw dice with me, back when we were young.

Xiaoyaozi

Ready to Become a Whale?

A "whale" refers to someone who spends an outrageous amount of money on online games.

They may be scorned for wasting money, but in the game world, their overwhelming strength earns admiration.

This is a simulation game where you can experience life as one of these legendary whales.

Take on part-time jobs, start a company, earn money, and sink it all into a virtual social game!

Work and Earn Money!

Plenty of job options are available. Find the one you like and start making money!

Run Your Own Business!

You can also start and manage your own company to generate higher profits.

Recruit Talented Employees!

Hiring skilled workers will boost your business’s earnings even further.

Spend Big in Online Games!

Use your earnings to spin the gacha and collect powerful characters!

Claim Victory in War Events!

Team up with trusted allies and take on powerful enemies!

Streaming & Video Guidelines

We warmly welcome gameplay videos, streams, and let's plays of this game. Monetization is also allowed.

Both individuals and organizations are free to create content without restriction.

If possible, please include the link to the Steam store page in the description of your video or stream.

A livestream management sim.

As a group-stream talent manager, you take your streamers and you run. Numbers keep climbing until they stand on the national guild-championship stage.

Of course, you're more than the operator behind the curtain. When the mood hits, you can jump in yourself, throw gifts, and fight the whole room for that number-one spot.

Just don't forget: outside the lights, you've still got a pile of your own problems to deal with.

【The stage is a battlefield】

In the livestream room, streamers go head-to-head. Winner holds the stage. Loser goes to the back of the line.

You decide who goes on. Gifts chain, the room heats up, and strangers in the audience start spending with you.

Keeping the room on rhythm is a craft in itself.

【After the stream】

The lights go down. There's still a lot to handle.

They're fighting for center, and a pile of small stuff is waiting. As their manager, you still have to look after them.

Maybe you can help her — or him — untangle it. Maybe you can't. Everyone has their own ending.

【Outside the lights】

Debt is required coursework for every talent manager — and maybe what's behind a lot of number-ones.

Behind the shine is pressure you can't see. Get your own house in order first, or throw everything at her — or him — to take the board.

Sixty days. Get them to number one. Get the books even. Buy the company and keep going together — or walk away on your own. That part is on you.

【Collect, then do it all again】

Collect their photos. Collect the endings you haven't seen.

Thousands of photos

Thousands of videos

Dozens of different endings

Sometimes you think money always wins. Sometimes money still can't fix everything.

【The stage】

Hundreds of dance performances. Popular high-energy tracks. You can drop in the songs you love, too.

Steam Workshop included.

We'll also partner with real MCN agencies and streamers, coming as DLC. Real people or AI — which one's better? We'll see.

【Who this is for】

People who like livestreams.

People who like dance.

People who want to turn a room around.

People who did tip, and got their heart broken for it.

Back the streamer you love.

See you at the top.

Saintwoodville — a village beneath the gaze of the sacred tree.

Here, a girl named Rachel has died.

You trace the memories surrounding her death, searching for the truth they hide.

- Story-driven psychological horror — No combat, no cheap jump-scares. Just a slow, tightening dread and a story you uncover one scene at a time.

- Retro pixel atmosphere — Top-down pixel art and the quiet air of a still village.

- Easy answers are everywhere — but the real question lies beyond them.

What Was Lost is a first-person puzzle game for two players, online through Steam. One of you plays Ben, in the family house as it was. The other plays Lily, in the same house years later.

You can't see each other's rooms. A clock that still has its hands on Ben's side is bare on Lily's. A drawer that's locked for one of you is open for the other. Most puzzles come down to one person describing something and the other finding it, so you'll talk a lot.

In Early Access

  • Chapters 1 to 4: the front hall, the kitchen and garden, the library, and the bedroom and garden. A pair usually takes about 2.5 hours.

  • Chapters 5 to 7 are coming in free updates.

  • Online co-op for two with push-to-talk voice chat built in. There is no split-screen and no matchmaking, so bring a friend.

  • There is no combat and no timer, and you can't fail a puzzle.

Accessibility

  • Subtitles and adjustable text size

  • Colorblind palette

  • Reduced motion for camera effects, screen shake and head bob

  • Partial controller support

  • Autosave at the start of each chapter

From the developer

I've always wanted to make games, even when I was younger. The problem was, it always seemed too expensive or like it would take way too much time.

Eventually, I decided to just go for it and make one myself. I wanted to make something fun for friends or couples to play together, inspired by the kind of co-op games I’ve always enjoyed.

It's just me making this game, so if you give it a try, I'd love to hear what you think. What worked, what didn't, and what could be better. The Steam forums are the best place to share feedback, and I read every post.

What Was That?!

What Was That?! is a cozy-spooky roguelite deckbuilder where you play as a household pet exploring a home after dark.

When the humans fall asleep, the house changes. Everyday objects become mysterious encounters. Some become friends. Others become enemies.

Explore different rooms, investigate strange objects, and face bizarre enemies inspired by things every pet knows — cardboard boxes, tangled yarn, robot vacuums, and more.

Build your deck, manage your Stress, and trust your instincts to survive until morning.

Features

  • 🐾 Play as a household pet.

  • 🃏 Build a unique deck during every run.

  • 🏠 Explore a home full of mysterious encounters.

  • 😺 Every object can become either a reward or a threat.

  • 🌙 Cozy atmosphere mixed with light suspense.

  • 🔄 Procedurally generated runs with different choices every night.

WELCOME TO YOUR NEXT SHIFT!


What a Shift! is a chaotic top-down restaurant management roguelite where every shift gets busier, messier, and harder to control.


Take orders, serve burgers, fries and drinks, keep customers happy, and try to hold your restaurant together for as long as you can. Growing queues, impatient customers, rush hours, station problems and even dirty restrooms can turn a smooth shift into complete chaos.

LEVEL UP. PICK A CARD. CHANGE THE RUN.


Earn XP during each shift and choose your upgrade cards when you level up. Shape your restaurant with upgrades that let you:


  • Improve production speed to keep up with demand.

  • Expand your restaurant and add furniture.

  • Reduce station problems to keep things running smoothly.


Build a different setup every run and adapt as the pressure grows.

KEEP EVERYTHING MOVING


Your job doesn't stop at serving food. Manage customer queues, deliver the right products, keep tables available, deal with problems around the restaurant and make sure customers don't run out of patience.


  • A dirty restroom can create another queue.

  • A broken station can slow down production.

  • One bad decision during a rush hour can cost you a life.

FAIL. UPGRADE. TRY AGAIN.


Every shift becomes more demanding until your restaurant eventually falls apart. But failure isn't the end.


Keep your earnings, unlock permanent upgrades and come back stronger for the next run.

HOW LONG CAN YOU SURVIVE YOUR NEXT SHIFT?

Wheat Awn: Line Zero is a single-player military-management game with turn-based card battles. A new campaign begins with two playable lessons. In battle, select a living enemy platoon, choose an officer and use one of that officer's available tactical cards; after your order resolves, the enemy takes its turn. In the Live-Fire Trial, move with WASD or the arrow keys and survive until the timer ends.

Go to the police station in Wheat Awn Town and speak to the Police Chief. Choose how long the trial will last, then dodge ricocheting boulders and machine-gun sweeps. Star Coins are added to the run every five seconds. Finish the timer to keep all of them. Death or early withdrawal erases only that run's earnings; coins owned before entering remain safe.

Use Star Coins in town to register each new group of 30 soldiers and form another platoon. Buy enough weapons for every soldier you deploy, together with medicine and special supplies. At the Academy, spend Star Coins to select officers. An officer can enter only courses matching their military attributes. Academy simulations provide both armies and their supplies, so they do not consume your inventory. Win a course and choose one of three tactical cards for that officer's field plan.

Return to the military compound, prepare your platoons and board the train. Every operation lists the required position, number of platoons and equipment before deployment. In battle, a tactical card works only when the deployed force contains the troops and equipment printed on it: infantry orders need armed infantry, armored orders need tanks, rocket orders need launchers, air orders need aircraft, and medical orders consume medicine. The Agent Radio reveals the enemy's next order and its effect, giving you a chance to prepare a counter.

The first nine warzones award promotions as your force grows from one 30-soldier platoon toward 729 platoons. Six final challenge warzones then test the army you built. Clear all 15 to finish the campaign; the ending records how many in-game days you needed.

Wheel Street is a strategy game that combines wheel-based placement with deckbuilding. Position your assets, combine powerful effects, and build a money-making machine where one carefully planned move can set off a spectacular chain of profits.

Clever Combos. Massive Payoffs.

Turn a small payout into a cascade of profits. Discover powerful card synergies, connect effects through careful placement, and watch your engine kick into high gear!

Profit on the Rise. Grow on the Fall.

Every market has its opportunities. Cash in when prices rise, and strengthen your assets when they fall. Turn a downturn into long-term potential, nurturing a standout asset that powers your entire build!

Face the Boss. Put Your Build to the Test.

Can your money-making machine withstand the pressure? Refine your wheel layout, rethink your card synergies, and see your carefully crafted combos rise to the challenge.

More Cards. More Possibilities.

Explore 75 Strategy Cards and 11 Tactic Cards, each opening up new possibilities. Experiment with different builds and discover your own path to fortune!

More cards are on the way! (ง๑ •̀_•́)ง

WHEN THE DAY COMES

When will that day come?

No one remembers anymore how much time has passed since a mysterious alien asteroid struck Earth.

At first, it seemed like just another disaster. Then an unknown virus appeared. Cities descended into chaos, millions of people vanished in just a few weeks, and the world as we knew it ceased to exist.

But that wasn’t the scariest part at all.

The sun stopped rising.

Now Earth lives in endless darkness, thick fog, and ceaseless rain. A real day has become such a rare occurrence that many consider it a beautiful legend of the past.

No one knows anymore...

Whether it will ever come at all.

That is exactly why the game is called When the Day Comes.

Welcome to a world that no longer belongs to humans

When the Day Comes is a hardcore top-down multiplayer survival game that combines exploration of a vast procedurally generated world, settlement building, technological advancement, intense co-op, PvP, research, and the fight for humanity’s future.

Every new playthrough generates a completely new map.

New cities.

New roads.

New villages.

New military bases.

New hospitals.

New stories.

Here, it’s impossible to memorize the map.

It’s impossible to remember the locations of resources.

It’s impossible to know in advance what awaits you around the next corner.

Every world is unique.

Every playthrough becomes a new story.

The First Few Minutes After You Start

You wake up in a completely unfamiliar house.

There’s no electricity.

There’s no cell service.

Outside the window, the night is pitch-black.

In the kitchen, you manage to find a half-empty can of food, an old kitchen knife, and a candle that’s almost burned out.

You light it.

The room fills with soft light.

For the first time, you feel a little calmer.

But not for long.

A dull thud is heard from somewhere outside.

Then another one.

Someone...

Or something...

Already knows there’s life inside the house.

This is where the real struggle for survival begins.

Every item matters

In the world of When the Day Comes, there are practically no useless items.

Over 300 different items could one day save your life.

A hammer will help you build fortifications.

An axe will let you gather wood.

Wire can be used to make traps.

A battery will provide electricity.

A gas canister will let you start a generator.

Medicines will save you after a serious injury.

Old books will help you unlock new crafting recipes.

Car parts will bring long-forgotten vehicles back to life.

Sometimes, the last battery you find turns out to be more valuable than an assault rifle.

Over 50 types of weapons

Use everything you can find.

Kitchen knives.

Tire irons.

Baseball bats.

Axes.

Machetes.

Pistols.

Shotguns.

Assault rifles.

Hunting rifles.

Homemade weapons.

But remember...

Every loud gunshot can attract far more infected than you can eliminate.

Sometimes silence is your most powerful weapon.

Explore a fallen civilization

Once upon a time, this place was teeming with life.

Thousands of cars used to drive along these roads.

People were saved in hospitals.

Machinery was manufactured in factories.

Store shelves were never empty.

Now everything is different.

Every house holds its own story.

Every hospital may hide vital medicines.

Every military facility could be either the greatest find... or a deadly trap.

You never know what awaits you inside.

Every outing is a risk.

To survive, you’ll have to constantly leave your shelter.

Search for food.

Gather water.

Find medicine.

Scout for building materials.

Collect fuel.

Repair vehicles.

Before every expedition, you have to think about dozens of things.

Will you have enough ammo?

Will you forget the first-aid kit?

Do you have a spare battery?

Is there enough gas?

Any small detail you overlook could be a matter of life and death.

Your home is your last stronghold.

Any building can be turned into a true stronghold for survivors.

Board up the windows.

Reinforce the doors.

Erect walls.

Build watchtowers.

Run electrical lines.

Set up generators.

Create storage areas.

Set up workshops.

Build laboratories.

Install floodlights.

Set traps.

Every base becomes unique.

But even the strongest defenses don’t guarantee safety.

Sometimes a single mistake is all it takes...

To lose everything.

Light is life

After the disaster, an ordinary light bulb became a luxury.

Candles.

Flashlights.

Kerosene lamps.

Generators.

Power grids.

Now these aren’t just household items.

They’re the only thing standing between you and the darkness.

Every evening, you have to make a choice.

Conserve fuel and sit in the dark.

Or start the generator, light up the shelter...

...and attract the attention of those lurking in the darkness.

Not every survivor is equally valuable.

The most precious resource in this world is people.

Some are irreplaceable.

Your settlement may be home to specialists on whom the future of the entire group depends.

Engineer

The engineer constantly studies the technologies they find.

Creates new blueprints.

Unlocks the ability to build stronger walls, complex electrical systems, automatic gates, modern generators, security floodlights, and new types of fortifications.

Without an Engineer, the settlement’s development slows down significantly.

Doctor

The Doctor researches the virus.

Studies the samples found.

Works in the lab.

Creates medicines.

And gradually brings humanity closer to creating a vaccine.

Every research project requires time, rare materials, and constant protection.

The Last Hope

Rumors continue to circulate around the world.

Some believe that humanity can still be saved.

Others are convinced that all is lost.

Who is right?

You’ll have to find the answer on your own.

As you explore the world, you’ll discover old documents, lab records, radio broadcasts, and military archives.

Step by step, the true story of the catastrophe will begin to unfold.

People Are More Dangerous Than the Infected

Other players can become allies.

Or your worst enemies.

Today, you’re defending the settlement together.

Tomorrow, they might come for your supplies.

Or for the people.

Engineer.

Doctor.

Any specialist can accelerate the settlement’s development.

That’s exactly why attacks aren’t just about resources.

Sometimes, people themselves become the main target.

By kidnapping an experienced engineer or doctor, the enemy gains a huge advantage.

That’s why you have to defend more than just the walls.

You also have to protect those who live behind them.

A vehicle isn’t just a means of transportation.

A car can save your life.

Or bring death right to the base’s gates.

Any vehicle requires fuel.

Repairs.

Spare parts.

A new battery.

A working engine.

Every time you start the engine, the noise carries for a long distance.

Sometimes it’s better to walk a few kilometers than to start the car.

Bloody Night

There is an event that even the most experienced survivors fear.

One day, the sky begins to slowly turn red.

The air grows heavy.

A thick crimson fog appears on the horizon.

A few minutes later, acid rain begins to fall.

Everyone understands...

The Bloody Night has begun.

Even the infected disappear

During the Bloody Night, the zombies disappear.

No one knows why.

But that’s no reason to rejoice.

Because that’s when the real nightmare begins.

Huge parasitic organisms, about the size of a large dog, emerge from the infected ground.

There are too many to count.

Thousands of creatures migrate in a continuous stream across the entire world.

They destroy everything in their path.

Don’t open the door

Just one unlocked door is enough.

If the creatures get inside...

They’ll fill the entire house.

The rooms.

The hallways.

The basement.

They reproduce quickly.

They can’t be stopped with conventional weapons.

While you’re killing a dozen...

Hundreds are already surrounding the shelter.

They’re afraid of light.

Light is the only thing that can stop the flood of parasites.

That’s exactly why generators are invaluable.

People are building floodlight towers.

They’re illuminating the walls.

They’re setting up backup power sources.

But an ordinary flashlight won’t save you.

There are too many of them.

If the generator stops...

The house will instantly be plunged into darkness.

And in a few seconds, you’ll hear something start to scrape along the walls.

They’ve found you.

Underground

Some survivors head into the sewer tunnels ahead of time.

Old sewer lines.

Underground utility tunnels.

It’s dangerous there, too.

But sometimes it’s the only chance to survive the Bloody Night.

The world never stands still

While you’re building your base...

Someone is exploring military laboratories.

While you’re repairing your car...

Others are developing new technologies.

While you’re searching for food...

Bloody Night can begin at any moment.

This world doesn’t pause.

It exists on its own.

And if you don’t keep up...

It will leave you behind.

When will the day come?

Millions of people have vanished.

Cities have been emptied.

The sky is no longer what it used to be.

But as long as there’s even one person left who keeps fighting...

Hope is still alive.

Perhaps you’ll be the one to uncover the truth.

Perhaps your settlement will become humanity’s last stronghold.

And perhaps...

You’ll be the one to witness the first true dawn.

If it ever comes at all.

A young red panda faces the flames destroying her forest home as a story unfolds.

When the Embers Wake is a third-person narrative adventure game where you play as a young Red Panda facing different emotional and environmental challenges as the story of the relationship with her mother is narrated.

Game Features

  • Third person exploration/walking simulator through the eyes of a red panda

  • Storytelling through narration, animation and environment

  • Hand-crafted environments to explore

  • Exploration and action interactions

  • 2-hour intimate narrative experience

  • Available on PC & Steam Deck​

Gameplay

A gentle, contemplative experience focused on exploration and emotional discovery

Exploration

Wander through hand-crafted environments that tell their own stories through visual details and atmospheric design.

Experience

Immerse yourself in a back story that goes through the childhood experiences of Emmie, a young woman faced with a difficult childhood, and how the relationship with her mother evolved.

Themes

Explore profound themes through gentle storytelling

Grief

Navigate the complex emotions of loss through a young red panda's journey of understanding and acceptance.

Deforestation

Witness the impact of environmental change on wildlife habitats and the creatures that call them home.

Emotional Resilience

Discover the quiet strength that emerges from vulnerability and the courage to continue despite loss.

​​

Will the embers take the forest?

■ Overview

Mariel, a kind-hearted fox girl, and Darksword, a wicked demon god.

Together, they set out on a journey across the world to gather followers.

"Where is my sword" is a card-collecting roguelite action game in which you'll overcome countless challenges by making use of the many items you find along the way.

■ Gameplay

Battles are hectic real-time action battles fought on a 3×6 grid!

Rummage through your bag for the card you need while dodging enemy attacks.

Cards in your hand can be used in two different ways:

• Use – Activate the card as a skill.
• Throw – Toss the card at enemies.

Cards keep piling up as you progress through towns, events, and battles.

Before long, your bag will be completely stuffed…

The fuller your bag becomes, the harder it is to find the card you need!

Keep digging through your bag in search of something powerful,

or adapt and make the most of the cards already in your hands.

Read the situation, make the most of what's in your bag,

and win each fight through smart dodging and well-timed attacks.

■ STORY

Deep in a mountain cave, a single sword was stuck in the ground.

Its name was Darksword, a demon god.

Long ago, he attempted to rule the world with his overwhelming power—but was defeated and sealed away.

In this remote place, Darksword eventually encounters a lone fox.

"I want to try eating human food."

Hearing this innocent wish, Darksword grants the fox a human body using his magic.

In exchange, the fox becomes Darksword's follower.

She promises to wield him as a sword and help gather more followers.

A kind-hearted fox girl who wants to befriend humans,

and a demon god who seeks to regain his power through followers.

Thus begins the strange journey of one fox and one sword!

■ About the Gameplay

Managing several actions at once is one of this game's core concepts.

As a result, the controls may feel a little difficult at first.

WHISPERING ECLIPSIA: AAKHIRI RAAT

Every clue tells a story. Every suspect hides a secret. Every shadow watches.

A murder. A missing truth. A nightmare waiting to be uncovered.

Step into the shoes of Inspector Keshav, a police investigator assigned to a disturbing murder case connected to the mysterious Woods Lane.

What begins as an ordinary criminal investigation slowly descends into a terrifying psychological nightmare, where every discovery raises new questions and every shadow conceals something sinister.

INVESTIGATE THE UNEXPLAINED

Search disturbing crime scenes, examine police reports, analyze mysterious evidence, and piece together the events surrounding the death of Sana Vyas.

Explore multiple interconnected locations, uncover hidden clues, and follow a trail of secrets that leads far beyond an ordinary murder investigation.

Every discovery brings you closer to the truth—or deeper into the darkness.

CCTV SURVEILLANCE & MONITORING

Sometimes, the camera sees what your eyes cannot.

Use CCTV surveillance systems to monitor suspicious activities, examine camera feeds, and uncover crucial information hidden within the environment.

Watch carefully. Every movement, every shadow, and every unexplained occurrence could hold an important clue.

But remember—not everything captured on camera can be explained.

EVERY SUSPECT HAS A SECRET

Question Ravi and investigate the complicated relationships connecting the people involved in the case.

Examine statements, uncover contradictions, and use collected evidence to progress through interrogations.

Every suspect has something to hide.

But can you trust what you discover?

EXPLORE MULTIPLE TERRIFYING LEVELS

Your investigation will take you through multiple atmospheric environments, each revealing another disturbing piece of the mystery.

From unsettling crime scenes and abandoned interiors to the terrifying depths of Woods Lane, every location presents new challenges, discoveries, and dangers.

Explore carefully. The environment itself may be hiding the answers you seek.

NIGHT VISION — SEE THROUGH THE DARKNESS

When darkness consumes everything, your vision becomes your only hope.

Use night-vision equipment to navigate poorly lit environments, investigate hidden areas, and reveal details concealed by darkness.

But seeing more doesn't always mean you're safer.

Some things are better left unseen.

PSYCHOLOGICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL HORROR

Fear doesn't always announce its arrival.

Experience an unsettling blend of psychological tension, disturbing environmental storytelling, eerie soundscapes, and unpredictable supernatural occurrences.

As the investigation progresses, familiar surroundings become increasingly threatening.

Strange noises echo through empty rooms. Shadows appear where nothing should exist. The line between reality and nightmare begins to disappear.

SUPERNATURAL ENCOUNTERS & JUMPSCARES

You're not alone in Woods Lane.

Encounter terrifying supernatural phenomena, disturbing apparitions, and unexpected jump scares designed to keep you constantly on edge.

Danger can emerge from the darkness when you least expect it.

And sometimes, running may be your only instinct.

  • First-Person Psychological Horror: Experience an immersive investigation filled with dread, uncertainty, and psychological tension.

  • Detective Investigation: Examine crime scenes, collect evidence, and uncover the truth behind a mysterious murder.

  • CCTV Surveillance System: Monitor camera feeds, investigate suspicious activity, and discover hidden clues.

  • Multiple Levels & Locations: Explore diverse environments connected by a dark and mysterious storyline.

  • Night Vision System: Navigate dark environments and investigate areas where ordinary visibility is limited.

  • Suspect Interrogation: Question suspects and progress through evidence-driven conversations.

  • Environmental Horror: Experience disturbing locations, atmospheric sound design, and unsettling environmental details.

  • Supernatural Encounters: Face unexplained phenomena, frightening apparitions, and unpredictable paranormal events.

  • Unexpected Jump scares: Stay alert as terrifying surprises threaten your sense of safety.

  • Story-Driven Mystery: Uncover a web of secrets, deception, and unexpected revelations.

THE TRUTH IS WAITING IN WOODS LANE.

Every secret has a price. Every nightmare has a beginning.

Will you uncover the truth before the darkness finds you?

Step aboard the Sentinel scientific vessel, which sent a distress signal before falling completely silent. As Elara Wynn, a researcher awakened from cryosleep aboard her own exploration ship, you find yourself at the heart of a mystery waiting to be unravelled.

What begins as a routine rescue mission, soon becomes a journey through dimly lit corridors, abandoned terminals, and silent decks of the Sentinel. With the ship's AI as your only companion, you uncover fragments of the crew's stories, read personal messages, and solve logical puzzles to delve deeper into the vessel's secrets.

Piece by piece, you learn what happened on the Sentinel—and why no one is responding.

Key Features:

  • Read emails, search for clues, and decipher codes that gradually reveal the story of the Sentinel.

  • Minigames and logic puzzles that unlock new decks and sealed systems.
